Pursuant to Regulation 30 & 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the Board of Directors of the Company at its Meeting held today, i.e., 5th August, 2026 have inter alia approved and taken on record the following:1 Setting up of a Denim Garment facility at approx. project cost of Rs. 186.30 crores in joint venture with NDS9 Private Limited. The Project Cost is proposed to be funded through equity contribution and term loans in the proposed ratio of 30% and 70% respectively, which may vary as per stipulation of the term lenders.2 Incorporation of the joint venture company as a Private Limited Company as LNJ NDS9 Global Private Limited (Proposed JV Company), which will become subsidiary of the Company upon incorporation and subscription of Shares of Proposed JV Company.

RSWM Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'The Board of Directors at its meeting held today, i.e. 13th May, 2025 was informed about the imposition of penalty by National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited under Regulation 17(1) and Regulation 17(1A) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. It was further informed to the Board that the penalty under Regulation 17 (1A) was reversed by NSE vide their letter dated 28th February, 2025. However, NSE vide its letter dated 11th March, 2025 imposed penalty of Rs.1,25,000/- under Regulation 17 (1) which was intimated to Stock Exchanges. The Company is awaiting the decision of BSE Limited in this regard.The Board discussed the matter and after discussion noted the same and advised to be more careful in future to avoid recurrence of such incidents.
Shri Manoj Kumar Bansal, Chief Transformation Officer has also been designated as Chief Risk Officer w.e.f. 13-05-2025.
